results.title: Innovating Assessments to Measure and Support Complex ...
results.content: This report explores new approaches to measuring complex skills through a practical and applied assessment design lens, bringing together perspectives from leading experts to consider what we can learn from the learning sciences to define more authentic assessment experiences and expand the range of skills we are able to measure in both disciplinary and cross-disciplinary contexts of practice. This volume makes the case for pursuing innovation in assessment in terms of the types of educational outcomes we should assess, the way we design tasks – capitalising on technology to generate rich and meaningful sources of data – and the processes required to ensure that assessments are valid given their intended use. Developing next-generation assessments will require the simultaneous investment of several types of capital: intellectual, involving different communities of experts in learning science, measurement science and data science to collaborate and solve conceptual and technical challenges; fiscal, to support the multidisciplinary teams required to design innovative assessments and bring promising examples to scale; and political, to buy into the vision to invest beyond the current possible and transform entrenched practices in assessment, and to assemble the fiscal capital required.
